content: We need template that when applied to target molecule (the product) gives precursors: from previous step, answer from make_8_lvl2-apply_template-2 gave precursors list: [["COc1ccccc1", "Nc1cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc([N+](=O)[O-])c1O"]]. So target molecule is COc1ccc(Nc2cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc([N+](=O)[O-])c2O)cc1. The template should be SNAr where halide broken, amine formed. Functional group formed is "primary amines" maybe? The list includes "primary amines", "secondary amines", "tertiary amines". The nucleophile is amine, product has an aniline (aryl amine). So functional_groups_formed should be "primary amines". Let's search with functional_groups_formed ["primary amines"] and broken ["halide"].
